391: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰਤਾ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਡਰਿਆ ॥
He, God, never dies, so we too need not fear death;
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕੜਿਆ ॥
He is never destroyed, so we too need not worry;
ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਨਿਰਧਨੁ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਭੂਖੇ ॥
He is not poor, so let us not think ourselves hungry or poor;
ਨਾ ਓਸੁ ਦੂਖੁ; ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਦੂਖੇ ॥੧॥
no pain touches Him, so no pain should touch us. ॥1॥
No one but Him has the power to kill us.
May He live for ever, the giver of our life. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਬੰਧਨ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
The bonds of Maya cannot hold Him, so in truth we too are not bound;
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਧੰਧਾ; ਨਾ ਹਮ ਧਾਧੇ ॥
no worldly chasing grips Him, so we too are not gripped by affairs;
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਮੈਲੁ; ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਮੈਲਾ ॥
the filth of vices cannot stain Him, so we too should stay unstained;
ਓਸੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ; ਤ ਹਮ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
He is ever in bliss, so let us too ever bloom. ॥2॥
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਸੋਚੁ; ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਸੋਚਾ ॥
No care touches Him, so no care should touch us;
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਲੇਪੁ; ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਪੋਚਾ ॥
Maya leaves no mark on Him, so why should it mark us?
ਨਾ ਉਸੁ ਭੂਖ; ਨ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ॥
no hunger for Maya presses Him, so no craving should grip us;
ਜਾ ਉਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਤਾਂ ਹਮ ਜਚਨਾ ॥੩॥
since He is pure, we too should stay pure. ॥3॥
We are nothing apart; He alone is in all.
Here and hereafter, He alone is everywhere.
O Nanak, when the Guru removed the illusions that stood in the way,
ਹਮ ਓਇ ਮਿਲਿ; ਹੋਏ ਇਕ ਰੰਗਾ ॥੪॥੩੨॥੮੩॥
we met Him and became one with Him. ॥4॥32॥83॥
O mother, one should serve her in many ways,
and lay life, breath and wealth before her.
Casting off pride, may I carry water for her and fan her,
and give myself up to her many times over. ॥1॥
She alone is the happy wife who is pleasing to God;
ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਉ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
may I sit in her company, O my mother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O mother, may I carry water for the maids of their maids;
ਉਨੑ ਕੀ ਰੇਣੁ; ਬਸੈ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
may the dust of their feet stay with my soul.
If fortune wakes on my forehead, I may gain their company,
and through it the Master meets me in His own love. ॥2॥
For their company I would give up all my chanting, austerities and disciplines,
and offer up all my religious rites and fire offerings.
Leaving pride and attachment, may I become the dust of their feet;
ਉਨੑ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਦੇਖਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੈਨ ॥੩॥
in their company I shall see God with these eyes. ॥3॥
Moment by moment I pray for this alone,
day and night I keep up this service.
the merciful Lord of the world becomes kind to her,
O Nanak, who reaches the company of the holy, and He forgives. ॥4॥33॥84॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
One who holds God's love in his heart has lasting joy;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗੈ ਨ. ਕੋਇ ॥
through God's love no pain can touch him;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
through God's love he removes the filth of pride;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਦ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
God's love keeps him ever pure. ॥1॥
Listen, friend, such a gift is love for God,
ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ; ਘਟ ਘਟ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that it becomes the support of the soul and breath of every being. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਭਏ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
One in whose heart God's love dwells has gained, as it were, all treasures;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਨਾਮ ॥
through God's love the purifying Name comes to dwell in his heart;
through God's love he is ever honoured;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਸਭ ਮਿਟੀ ਹੈ ਚਿੰਤ ॥੨॥
through God's love all his worry is wiped out. ॥2॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਇਹੁ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰੈ ॥
One in whose heart God's love dwells crosses this world-ocean;
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਡਰੈ ॥
through God's love he does not fear the messengers of death;
through God's love he keeps from vices and saves all others too.
God's love is the wealth that goes along with a person for ever. ॥3॥
No one stays joined to God by his own effort, nor strays by it;
on whom God is merciful, He joins him with the company of the holy.
Says Nanak: I give myself up to You;
O God, You are the shelter of the saints and their strength. ॥4॥34॥85॥
If someone became a king and enjoyed his rule,
and gathered wealth by wronging people again and again,
392: and piling it up, made a treasure of it,
ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਉਸ ਤੇ ਡਾਰਿ; ਅਵਰ ਕਉ ਦੀਨੑੀ ॥੧॥
God snatched it from him and gave it to another. ॥1॥
The human body is like a pot of unbaked clay set in water;
ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ; ਉਆਹੂ ਮਹਿ ਪਰੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
through pride upon pride a person sinks in that very ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
If, proud of his rule, he became fearless and heedless of death,
if the Creator who dwells with him never came to his mind,
if he gathered troops into a great army,
ਨਿਕਸਿਆ ਫੂਕ; ਤ ਹੋਇ ਗਇਓ ਸੁਆਹਾ ॥੨॥
when his breath left him, his body became dust. ॥2॥
If he had high mansions and palaces, and a queen,
if he gathered elephants, horses and clothes to his liking,
if he had a great family of sons and daughters,
still, ruined again and again by attachment and blind in it, he brought on spiritual death. ॥3॥
The One who created him also destroyed him;
his pleasures and revels became like a dream.
He alone stays free of Maya's attachment, and his is lasting rule and wealth,
O servant Nanak, on whom the Master is kind. ॥4॥35॥86॥
If we love this Maya greatly,
the more we keep with her, the more our attachment grows.
When she clings to the neck and will not let go,
release comes only by falling at the true Guru's feet. ॥1॥
Since I renounced and cast away Maya, who enchants the world,
I have met God beyond the three qualities, and joy has risen within me. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
She is so lovely that she charms the mind at once;
ਬਾਟਿ ਘਾਟਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ; ਬਨਿ ਬਨਿ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
on the road, at the ford, at home, in forest after forest, she lies in wait.
ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਮੀਠੀ ॥
Becoming sweet, she clings to mind and body.
By the Guru's grace I have seen that she is false. ॥2॥
Her courtiers, lust and the rest, are great cheats too;
they spare no one, be it father or mother.
All who kept company with them they bound fast;
ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ; ਮੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥੩॥
by the Guru's grace I have brought them all under control. ॥3॥
Now my mind abides in spiritual joy;
my fear of them is gone and all their nooses are broken.
O Nanak, since I found the true Guru,
I have settled my whole house in peace. ॥4॥36॥87॥
God's devotee knows Him to be near him all eight watches,
and accepts whatever God does as sweet.
The one Name is the support of the saints;
ਹੋਇ ਰਹੇ; ਸਭ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਛਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
they remain the dust of everyone's feet. ॥1॥
O my brother, hear the way of life of a saint;
ਉਆ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
his greatness cannot be told. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
A saint is one whose heart is occupied only with the Name,
whose support is the praise of God, who is ever in bliss.
ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨੈ ॥
one to whose mind friend and enemy look alike,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਿਨੁ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
for he sees none but his own God in all. ॥2॥
God's saint has the power to remove millions upon millions of others' sins.
ਦੁਖ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਨ; ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ ॥
God's saints can remove others' pain and give them spiritual life.
They are heroes against the vices and keep their word.
The saints have brought poor, humble Maya under their control. ॥3॥
Even the gods of the heavens long to meet God's saint.
ਅਮੋਘ ਦਰਸੁ; ਸਫਲ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
His sight is never in vain, and his service surely bears fruit.
O God, treasure of virtues, grant me the service of the saints. ॥4॥37॥88॥
All joys are gained by repeating the one Name.
ਸਗਲ ਧਰਮ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਮ ॥
All other religious duties are contained in singing God's praises.
The company of the Guru makes one utterly pure,
393: and meeting the Guru, love for God springs up. ॥1॥
One whose mind is lit up by the Guru's grace,
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ. ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਾ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ. ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
remembering God's Name, enjoys many joys; his high state and greatness cannot be told. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
For him, as it were, all fasts and disciplines, pilgrim baths and worship are done;
he has, as it were, heard the Vedas, Puranas and Smritis,
ਮਹਾ ਪੁਨੀਤ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
one whose heart becomes utterly holy and pure,
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ; ਜਾ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
and in whose heart the Lord's Name dwells through the Guru's company. ॥2॥
That person becomes known in all the worlds;
ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਰੇਨ ॥
the dust of his feet can purify many fallen in vices.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਓ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ॥
One whom the Lord King meets,
ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
his high state and greatness cannot be told. ॥3॥
O God, may I meditate on You all eight watches with palms joined,
and keep the sight of those holy ones.
Join me, poor as I am, with their company,
O Nanak, those who have come to Your shelter. ॥4॥38॥89॥
He who bathes in the waters all eight watches,
who knows every heart well and ever takes the offering within all beings,
who leaves no one's pain remaining,
at His feet we fall again and again. ॥1॥
Serving God is the saligram worship in our house;
remembering His Name is our worship, offering of incense and bowing. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਘੰਟਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ; ਸੁਨੀਐ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ॥
The bell of His will is heard through the whole world, not in a temple alone.
His seat is ever in the paradise of the company of the holy.
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਚਵਰੁ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਝੂਲੈ ॥
His fan of air waves over all beings.
All plants ever in flower: that is His incense. ॥2॥
ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸੰਪਟੁ; ਹੈ ਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਾ ॥
He dwells in every body; every heart is His casket,
His assembly of saints never ends, and He dwells ever with the holy,
where His praise goes on, giving lasting bliss; that praise is His arti,
and the greatness of the beautiful, boundless One is ever sung. ॥3॥
He alone finds Him in whose fortune it is written.
That person falls at the saints' feet and stays in their shelter.
He finds the Lord, the true saligram,
Says Nanak: he to whom the Guru gave the gift of the Name. ॥4॥39॥90॥
The path on which the soul caught in vices is robbed of her wealth
O God, one to whom the perfect true Guru taught Your eternal Name,
ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਬੀਥੀ; ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
finds an open path through Your Name, and the way of death stays far from him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The ford where the greedy tax collectors of death stand,
ਦੂਰਿ ਰਹੀ; ਉਹ ਜਨ ਤੇ ਬਾਟ ॥੨॥
that path stays far from the saints. ॥2॥
Where many caravans of beings are tormented on life's journey,
the Gurmukhs stay companions of the supreme Lord. ॥3॥
Chitra and Gupta write the account of all beings' deeds,
ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ; ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਨ ਪੇਖਾ ॥੪॥
but they cannot even lift their eyes towards the devotees. ॥4॥
Says Nanak: one who meets the perfect true Guru,
in his heart the unbroken music of God's praise ever plays. ॥5॥40॥91॥
Those whom the Guru teaches the Name, keeping them in his company,
have all their aims and all their tasks fulfilled.
ਬੁਝਿ ਗਈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ; ਹਰਿ ਜਸਹਿ ਅਘਾਨੇ ॥
Their fire of craving is put out; dwelling in God's praise, they stay sated.
As I repeat the Name of God, spiritual life springs up in me. ॥1॥
One who takes the shelter of God, the doer and cause of all,
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ. ਚੰਦੁ ਚੜਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
finds by the Guru's grace the home of stillness of mind; darkness goes and the moon rises within. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
394: Lofty virtues are rubies and jewels, and their stores fill up within;
they never run short, by repeating the Name of the Formless One.
The Guru's word is the life-giving water; whoever drinks it,
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੪੧॥੯੨॥
O Nanak, reaches the highest spiritual state. ॥2॥41॥92॥
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
By the Guru's grace I ever meditate on God's Name in my heart,
and I am able to carry all my companions, my senses, across. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
My Guru is always with me, ever by my side.
ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Remembering Him again and again, I keep Him ever in my heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
O God, all that You do seems sweet to me,
and Nanak begs of You the treasure of Your Name. ॥2॥42॥93॥
Through the company of the Guru one crosses the world-ocean,
for God's Name becomes the support of his mind. ॥1॥
The lotus feet of the beloved Guru
ਪੂਜਹਿ ਸੰਤ; ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the saints of the Lord worship with love and affection. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One on whose forehead the written fortune wakes,
Says Nanak: his good fortune lasts for ever. ॥2॥43॥94॥
Since my Husband's will has seemed sweet to me,
the Husband has rid me of my rival, Maya, who held my heart's home.
Making me His happy wife, my Beloved has adorned me,
and has taken away the burning of my mind. ॥1॥
My fortune woke when I began to accept my Beloved's will;
ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ; ਇਸੁ ਘਰ ਕਾ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
now I am at one with the peace and stillness of mind in this heart's home. ॥ Rahao ॥
I have become my Beloved's maid and servant.
He is undying, unreachable and boundless.
Since I stand at His feet with a fan in hand, fanning my Beloved,
the five enemies that cut at my roots have fled. ॥2॥
I have no high family, nor am I honoured for any virtue;
I do not know how I have come to please my Husband.
Me, an orphan, poor and without honour,
the Husband has taken by the arm and made His queen. ॥3॥
Since I met my beloved Friend,
I have joy and stillness of mind; my fortune has woken.
Says Nanak: my hope is fulfilled;
the true Guru has joined me with God, the treasure of virtues. ॥4॥1॥95॥
She has a frown on her forehead and a glance full of anger;
she speaks bitterly and has a harsh tongue.
She stays ever hungry and thinks the Husband is far away. ॥1॥
O my brother, God has created such a woman, Maya,
ਉਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ; ਹਮ. ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that she has devoured the whole world; the Guru has saved me, O my brother. ॥ Rahao ॥
Feeding it a drugging herb, she has kept the whole world in her sight.
She has caught Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva in her attachment.
The Gurmukhs who stay joined to the Name live a beautiful spiritual life. ॥2॥
Many have tired themselves with fasts, vows and rites of atonement,
and wandered to all the pilgrim shores and over the whole earth.
ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ; ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
Only those are saved who take the true Guru's shelter. ॥3॥
The whole world is bound by attachment to Maya;
the foolish one who follows his own mind is ruined in pride.
ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ; ਬਾਹ ਪਕਰਿ. ਹਮ ਰਾਖਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੯੬॥
O Nanak, say: O Guru, You took me by the arm and saved me. ॥4॥2॥96॥
O Master, when You are forgotten, all pains close in;
such a being is of no use here or hereafter. ॥1॥
The saints are content, meditating on the Lord.
395: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਅਪੁਨੈ ਨਾਇ ਲਾਏ; ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ. ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਰਜਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, those You mercifully keep joined to Your Name remember it and stay sated, free of the thirst for Maya. ॥ Rahao ॥
Whoever thinks God, who dwells beside him, lives far away,
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮਰਤਾ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਝੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
that person, fretting day after day, brings spiritual death on himself. ॥2॥
ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਚਿਤਵਤ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
One who does not remember the God who gave him everything,
ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ; ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
his days and nights pass caught in the grip of mighty Maya. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: keep remembering the one God,
and through the support of the perfect Guru the high spiritual state is reached. ॥4॥3॥97॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
By repeating the Name, mind and heart become spiritually alive, like a tree that turns green with water;
all sins and faults are driven out. ॥1॥
O my brother, that day alone is blessed
ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
on which one sings God's praises and attains the highest spiritual state. ॥ Rahao ॥
One who worships the feet of the Gurmukhs,
from his mind all mischief and enmity are wiped away. ॥2॥
One who meets the perfect Guru and ends the clamour of vices within,
brings all five enemies, lust and the rest, under his control. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
One in whose mind the Name of God comes to dwell,
O Nanak, to him one should always be a sacrifice. ॥4॥4॥98॥
While you have the power to sing, keep singing the praises of God,
who is the support of your soul, your body and your breath,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ; ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
by whose service you will gain every comfort,
ਅਵਰ ਕਾਹੂ ਪਹਿ; ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
and you will never need to go to anyone else again. ॥1॥
ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ. ਅਨੰਦੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪੀਐ ॥
One should repeat for ever the Master, the treasure of virtues, who is the source of lasting bliss.
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਾਸੀਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
One should be a sacrifice to that beloved Guru by whose grace God is made to dwell in the mind. ॥ Rahao ॥
He whose gift never runs out,
and in whom all who enshrine Him rest well in stillness of mind,
ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬਖਸ; ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
He whose grace no one can obstruct,
that eternal God alone should be kept dwelling in the mind. ॥2॥
ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ; ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪੂਰਨ ॥
He in whose house all things are stored in full,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ; ਦੂਖ ਨ ਝੂਰਨ ॥
whose servants no pain or grief can touch,
whose shelter, once taken, brings the state where no fear can press,
ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ; ਸੋ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
that treasure of virtues should be praised with every breath. ॥3॥
God does not live far from us; there is no need to go anywhere to search for Him;
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
He is found only when He Himself casts His glance of grace.
I make my prayer only to the perfect Guru:
Nanak begs for the wealth of God's Name, the capital of the Name. ॥4॥5॥99॥
First every pain of my body was removed,
then my mind came to full joy.
In His mercy the Guru gave me the Name of God;
ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
I am a sacrifice, again and again, to that true Guru. ॥1॥
O my brother, ever since I found the perfect Guru,
ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭ ਦੂਖ ਬਿਨਾਸੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
in the Guru's refuge all my ailments, anxieties and pains have been destroyed. ॥ Rahao ॥
Since I enshrined the Guru's feet in my heart,
I have been receiving every fruit my mind desires.
The fire of craving has gone out, and complete coolness has settled within;
all this gift the Guru gave out of his mercy. ॥2॥
I found shelter nowhere before; the Guru gave me a place at his feet;
to me, without honour, the Guru gave respect;
cutting my bonds of attachment to Maya, he made me his servant and kept me at his feet;
now my tongue keeps tasting the life-giving word of praise. ॥3॥
By great good fortune I was given to worship the Guru's feet,
through which I left every other support and came to God's refuge.
396: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਭਇਆ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
O Nanak, the one on whom the Guru becomes merciful,
that person always enjoys spiritual bliss. ॥4॥6॥100॥
The eternal God has sent the Guru, Nanak, into the world.
By the blessing of his company, lasting spiritual life is springing up in the hearts of the Sikhs.
Just as when a child comes to dwell in the womb,
great joy arises in the mother's mind, so this lasting life brings bliss to the Sikh. ॥1॥
Guru Nanak, a devotee of God, a son of God, has been born.
ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ; ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰ ਕਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In all who come to his refuge, the writ of devotion from God's court is coming to light. ॥ Rahao ॥
ਦਸੀ ਮਾਸੀ; ਹੁਕਮਿ. ਬਾਲਕ ਜਨਮੁ ਲੀਆ ॥
As when, by God's command, a son is born in a house in the tenth month,
grief leaves that house and there is great rejoicing,
so the companion of the holy company who sings the Guru's word of praise
enjoys spiritual bliss and is dear to the mind of the eternal Lord. ॥2॥
Those Sikhs are the growing vine, the generation carrying on,
in whom the Guru makes the power of God's dharma firm and settled.
The true Guru grants them the fruit their minds desire;
those who fix their attention on the one God become free of anxiety. ॥3॥
ਜਿਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ; ਪਿਤਾ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
As a son takes great pride in his father, so the Sikh takes pride in the Guru and looks to him for help;
whatever he says, he speaks as prompted by the Guru, within the Guru's will.
This is no hidden or secret matter now:
everyone knows that on whom Guru Nanak is pleased, he bestows the gift. ॥4॥7॥101॥
The servant whom the perfect Guru protects by giving him his hand,
his glory becomes manifest throughout the world. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਪੀ; ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
I remember only the Guru, always; I meditate only on the Guru.
ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ; ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਪਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
From the Guru alone I receive what my mind prays for. ॥ Rahao ॥
Those servants who take the shelter of the true Guru, the image of the eternal God,
find their labour of service brought to fulfilment. ॥2॥
The Guru keeps the soul, body, youth and breath of the servant in his refuge safe from vices.
Says Nanak: such a servant should hand himself over to the Guru. ॥3॥8॥102॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ਬੈ ਖਰੀਦੁ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
My Master is eternal; I am His bought slave.
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ; ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
My soul and body are all given by that Master; O Lord, whatever I have is Yours. ॥1॥
ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੇ ਤੂੰ ਧਣੀ; ਤੇਰਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
O Lord, You are the honour of me who have no honour; my trust is in You alone.
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ. ਅਨ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ; ਸੋ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਕਾਚਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Whoever leans on any hope other than the eternal God, know that his life is still weak. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਹੈ; ਕੋਈ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
O Lord, Your command is boundless; no one can find its limit.
ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਸੀ; ਸੋ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਏ ॥੨॥
The one who meets the perfect Guru walks in Your will. ॥2॥
ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ; ਕਿਤੈ. ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈਐ ॥
A person tries countless clever tricks for comfort, but no cleverness is of any use;
ਤੁਠਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਜੋ ਦੇਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
only that comfort can be had which the Master gives when He is pleased. ॥3॥
ਜੇ ਲਖ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਈਅਹਿ; ਕਿਛੁ. ਪਵੈ ਨ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
Though a hundred thousand ritual deeds are done, nothing can bar the path of pain.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੀਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਰ; ਹੋਰੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਧੰਧਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੦੩॥
O servant Nanak, say: I have made the Name my support and given up all other running about. ॥4॥1॥103॥
ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਮੈ ਭਾਲਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
I have searched through all the comforts of the world; none equals union with God,
ਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੇ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੧॥
and that eternal Master is found only through the Guru when he is pleased. ॥1॥
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ; ਸਦ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨਾ ॥
I am a sacrifice to my Guru, for ever and ever devoted.
ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਚਸਾ; ਇਹੁ ਕੀਜੈ ਦਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Guru, give me this gift, that I never forget the Name for a moment, not for an instant. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭਾਗਠੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸੁ. ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ॥
He alone is the real wealthy man in whose heart dwells the wealth of God's Name.
397: ਸੋ ਛੂਟੈ ਮਹਾ ਜਾਲ ਤੇ; ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ॥੨॥
He escapes the great net of attachment to Maya within whom the Guru's word stays unbroken. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ. ਕਿਆ ਕਹਾ; ਗੁਰੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਸਤ ਸਰੁ ॥
I cannot tell how great the Guru is; the Guru is a lake of discernment, a lake of high conduct.
ਓਹੁ ਆਦਿ ਜੁਗਾਦੀ ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗੁ; ਪੂਰਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ॥੩॥
The Guru is the form of that perfect Lord who is the beginning of all, from before the ages, present in every age. ॥3॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੇ ॥
Remember the Name for ever and ever, and keep your mind dyed in the colour of God's love.
ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਸੰਗੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੦੪॥
The Guru, from whom the Name comes, dwells beside me, Nanak; the Guru is my soul, my breath and my wealth. ॥4॥2॥104॥
ਸਾਈ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ; ਭੋਰੀ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
O mother, when the unseen, boundless Master dwells in my mind even for a little while,
ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਮਾਇ; ਮੈਡਾ ਹਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥੧॥
every pain, ache and ailment of mine runs away. ॥1॥
O mother, I am a sacrifice to my Master.
ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਾਪਣੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By repeating His Name great joy arises in my mind and heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਿੰਦਕ ਗਾਲੑਿ ਸੁਣੀ; ਸਚੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਧਣੀ ॥
O mother, when I hear even a little of the praise of that eternal Master,
ਸੂਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ; ਮਾਇ. ਨ ਕੀਮ ਗਣੀ ॥੨॥
I feel a joy so high that I cannot tell its worth. ॥2॥
ਨੈਣ ਪਸੰਦੋ ਸੋਇ; ਪੇਖਿ ਮੁਸਤਾਕ ਭਈ ॥
O my mother, that Master is dear to my eyes; beholding Him, I am enraptured.
ਮੈ ਨਿਰਗੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ; ਆਪਿ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਲਈ ॥੩॥
O mother, I have no virtue, yet He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe. ॥3॥
ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਸੰਸਾਰ; ਹਭਾ ਹੂੰ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥
My King dwells beyond this visible world too, everywhere, and no scripture, Vedas or Semitic books, can describe Him.
Yet the King of Nanak is seen plainly in every place. ॥4॥3॥105॥
ਲਾਖ ਭਗਤ ਆਰਾਧਹਿ; ਜਪਤੇ ਪੀਉ ਪੀਉ ॥
O Lord, hundreds of thousands of Your devotees worship You, repeating Your Name and calling You, Beloved, Beloved.
ਕਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਉ; ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਬਿਖਈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
Beside them I am a being without virtue and full of vice; by what way can I meet You? ॥1॥
ਤੇਰੀ ਟੇਕ; ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਪਾਲ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥
O Govind, O Gopal, O merciful Lord, Your support is all I have.
ਤੂੰ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are the Master of all beings; the whole creation is made by You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਸੰਤ; ਪੇਖਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
O Lord, You are ever the helper of Your saints, and they always see You dwelling beside them,
ਨਾਮ ਬਿਹੂਨੜਿਆ; ਸੇ ਮਰਨੑਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ਵਿਸੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
but those deprived of Your Name, grieving and grieving, bring spiritual death on themselves. ॥2॥
ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਤਣ ਭਾਇ; ਮਿਟਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗਉਣੁ ॥
O Lord, for those who stay in the spirit of being slaves of Your slaves, the round of birth and death is ended,
ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਿਨਾੜਾ ਹਾਲੁ ਕਉਣੁ ॥੩॥
but those who forget Your Name, what a sorry state is theirs! ॥3॥
ਜੈਸੇ ਪਸੁ ਹਰੑਿਆਉ; ਤੈਸਾ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਭ ॥
As an animal let loose wanders grazing on green crops, so the whole world strays after vices.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ; ਮਿਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੦੬॥
O Nanak, say: O Lord, cut my bonds of vice and keep me joined to Your feet Yourself. ॥4॥4॥106॥
ਹਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ; ਹਿਕੋ ਖਿਆਲੁ ਕਰਿ ॥
Forget your attachment to all worldly things, and meditate on the one God alone.
ਝੂਠਾ ਲਾਹਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ; ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਧਰਿ ॥੧॥
Cast off the false pride of possessions, and offer up your mind and heart to Him. ॥1॥
O Creator Lord, by praising You through all eight watches
ਜੀਵਾਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਦਾਤਿ; ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ. ਮੂੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I live spiritually; have mercy on me, that I may receive the gift of Your praise. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੋਈ ਕੰਮੁ ਕਮਾਇ; ਜਿਤੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਉਜਲਾ ॥
Do only that work by which your face stays bright, here and hereafter.
ਸੋਈ ਲਗੈ ਸਚਿ; ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ ਅਲਾ ॥੨॥
But, O Lord, only the one to whom You give this gift is joined to Your eternal Name. ॥2॥
ਜੋ. ਨ ਢਹੰਦੋ ਮੂਲਿ; ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
Make beautiful that house of the heart, built of spiritual life, which can never fall down.
ਹਿਕੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਾਇ; ਕਦੇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਮਰਿ ॥੩॥
Keep the one God dwelling in your mind; He never dies. ॥3॥
ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਰਾਮੁ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
Those who become pleasing to God come to find God dear,
and by the Guru's grace Nanak has begun to praise the Lord of countless virtues. ॥4॥5॥107॥
ਜਿਨੑਾ. ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸੇ ਕਿਨੇਹਿਆ ॥
Do you know what they are like, those who never forget the Name?
ਭੇਦੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਮੂਲਿ; ਸਾਂਈ ਜੇਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
Know there is no difference at all between them and the Master; they become like Him. ॥1॥
ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ; ਤੁਮੑ ਸੰਗਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ॥
O Lord, those who keep company with You stay glad in mind.
ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੇਟਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By the grace of Your servant, the Guru, they have found spiritual bliss and wiped out all their pain. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੇਤੇ ਖੰਡ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ; ਉਧਾਰੇ ਤਿੰਨੑ ਖੇ ॥
Such people gain the power to save even all the continents and worlds from the world-ocean;
ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ; ਪੂਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੇ ॥੨॥
those in whose hearts God Himself has come to dwell become complete devotees. ॥2॥
398: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨੇ ਆਪਿ; ਸੋਈ ਮਾਨੀਐ ॥
The one whom God Himself honours is honoured everywhere;
ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ; ਸਭ ਠਾਈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥੩॥
he becomes renowned in every place, here and hereafter, and is accepted everywhere. ॥3॥
ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ; ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ॥
Worshipping You day and night, may Nanak keep You in his heart with every breath:
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਚਾ ਪੂਰਿ; ਸਚੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੦੮॥
O my eternal King, fulfil this longing of Nanak. ॥4॥6॥108॥
ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਇ; ਹਮਾਰਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
Our Master pervades every place; He is the one Master of all beings.
ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ; ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
The canopy of sovereignty over all creation is over His head alone; there is no other equal to Him. ॥1॥
O Lord, able to protect all beings, protect me as it pleases You.
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ; ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Apart from You I have never yet seen with my eyes any other like You. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰੀਐ ॥
God, seated in every body, takes care of each one and sustains each one.
ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਆਪਿ; ਤਿਸੁ. ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
The one in whose mind He Himself dwells, He never forgets again. ॥2॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪਿ; ਆਪਣ ਭਾਣਿਆ ॥
Whatever is being done in the world, God Himself does by His own will;
ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਸਹਾਈ; ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
it is well known that in every age He has helped His devotees. ॥3॥
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
Repeating God's Name again and again, one never again has to worry about anything.
O Lord, Nanak thirsts for Your sight; fulfil this longing. ॥4॥7॥109॥
ਕਿਆ ਸੋਵਹਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ; ਗਾਫਲ ਗਹਿਲਿਆ ॥
O heedless, careless mind, why do you sleep in attachment to Maya, forgetting the Name?
Countless beings are being swept away in this river of the world. ॥1॥
ਬੋਹਿਥੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ; ਮਨ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘੀਐ ॥
O mind, God's feet are a fine ship; boarding it, one crosses the world-ocean.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ; ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
So stay in the Guru's company and keep singing God's praises through all eight watches. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭੋਗਹਿ ਭੋਗ ਅਨੇਕ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੁੰਞਿਆ ॥
People enjoy countless pleasures, but without the Name they are left empty of spiritual life.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ; ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਰੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
Without devotion to God they keep inviting spiritual death and suffering. ॥2॥
ਕਪੜ ਭੋਗ ਸੁਗੰਧ; ਤਨਿ ਮਰਦਨ ਮਾਲਣਾ ॥
People wear fine clothes, eat tasty food and rub fragrant pastes on the body,
ਬਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਨ. ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ; ਸਰਪਰ ਚਾਲਣਾ ॥੩॥
but without remembrance that body is as good as ash, and it must surely perish in the end. ॥3॥
Only a rare one has seen that this world-ocean is terribly treacherous.
ਛੂਟਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ; ਲੇਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਲੇਖਿਆ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੧੦॥
O Nanak, say: escape from it is only in God's refuge, for the one on whose brow that writ is written. ॥4॥8॥110॥
ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ; ਕਾਹੇ ਗਰਬੀਐ ॥
No one stays with anyone for ever; why take pride in kin?
The Name alone is the real support; by it the terrifying world-ocean is crossed. ॥1॥
ਮੈ ਗਰੀਬ. ਸਚੁ ਟੇਕ ਤੂੰ; ਮੇਰੇ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ॥
O my perfect true Guru, You are eternal; You are the only prop of poor me.
ਦੇਖਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰਾ ਦਰਸਨੋ; ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਧੀਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Seeing Your sight, my mind takes courage to cross the world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਾਜੁ ਮਾਲੁ ਜੰਜਾਲੁ; ਕਾਜਿ ਨ ਕਿਤੈ. ਗਨੋੁ ॥
Kingship and riches are entanglements that hold the mind; count them of no use in the end.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ; ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਹੁ ਧਨੋੁ ॥੨॥
God's praise is the soul's true support; this is the wealth that lasts for ever. ॥2॥
All the pleasures and shows of Maya pass like a shadow.
ਸੁਖ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਵਿਆ ॥੩॥
The Name is the treasure of all comforts; it is praised only in the Guru's refuge. ॥3॥
ਸਚਾ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਤੂੰ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੇ ॥
O Lord, You are deep and large of heart, eternal, the treasure of all virtues.
ਆਸ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਜੀਅਰੇ ॥੪॥੯॥੧੧੧॥
O soul of Nanak, keep your hope and your trust in the Master alone. ॥4॥9॥111॥
ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ; ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
God, by remembering whom every pain goes and the joy of stillness of mind is found,
ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
should be meditated on day and night with hands joined before Him. ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ; ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
Nanak's Lord is the One whose creation every being is.
ਸਰਬ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ; ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He pervades all beings; He is eternal, He alone is eternal. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਹਾਈ ਗਿਆਨ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
He dwells within all and throughout the world, stays with all and helps all, and to know Him deeply is essential;
ਤਿਸਹਿ ਅਰਾਧਿ ਮਨਾ; ਬਿਨਾਸੈ ਸਗਲ ਰੋਗੁ ॥੨॥
O mind, worship Him, and every ailment is destroyed. ॥2॥
The boundless Protector, able to save all, protects each being in the fire of the womb;
399: ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਸਿਮਰਤ ਤਪਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
God's Name brings coolness to the mind; remembering it, the heat of craving is quenched. ॥3॥
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਣਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
O Nanak, say: one who stays in the dust of the feet of the saints has great comfort and joy of stillness of mind;
ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਿਧਿ ਭਏ; ਭੇਟਿਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੧੧੨॥
one who meets the perfect Guru finds success in all his tasks. ॥4॥10॥112॥
God is the treasure of all virtues; only in the Guru's refuge is a deep bond with Him formed,
ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ; ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥੧॥
and if He is kind and merciful, His love can be enjoyed. ॥1॥
ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਹ; ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਾਣੀਆ ॥
Come, O saints, let us sit together and talk of the praises of God,
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਿਮਰਹ ਨਾਮੁ; ਤਜਿ ਲਾਜ ਲੋਕਾਣੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and setting aside what people will say, let us remember His Name at every moment. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
As I repeat the Name, spiritual life arises in me and great joy springs up within.
Then I see that attachment to the world is futile; the world is not lasting and is bound to perish. ॥2॥
ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹੁ; ਕਿਨੈ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
Only a rare one has formed love for God's lotus feet.
ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਮੁਖੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
Blessed and beautiful is the face of one who has meditated on God. ॥3॥
ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਲ; ਸਿਮਰਤ. ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਵਈ ॥
Remembering the Name, the pain of the round of birth and death is wiped out.
ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਸੋਇ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੧੧੩॥
Whatever pleases God brings joy to Nanak's heart. ॥4॥11॥113॥
ਆਵਹੁ ਮੀਤ. ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਹੋਇ; ਰਸ ਕਸ ਸਭਿ ਭੁੰਚਹ ॥
Come, friends, let us gather and repeat God's Name; this is every delicacy, so let us enjoy them all.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਹ; ਮਿਲਿ. ਪਾਪਾ ਮੁੰਚਹ ॥੧॥
Let us repeat the life-giving Name of God, and together cast off our sins. ॥1॥
ਤਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ; ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਘਨੁ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
O saints, reflect on the real aim of human life; through this effort no obstacle befalls,
ਖੀਨ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਤਸਕਰਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
all the thieves, lust and the rest, are destroyed, for in the Guru's refuge a person stays alert. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬੁਧਿ ਗਰੀਬੀ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈਹੁ; ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰਹੁ ॥
O saints, take a humble mind as provisions for life's journey, and burn away pride, the poison.
ਸਾਚਾ ਹਟੁ, ਪੂਰਾ ਸਉਦਾ; ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਾਪਾਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
The Guru's house is the eternal shop where the full bargain is had; buy the merchandise of the Name. ॥2॥
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪਿਆ; ਸੇਈ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ॥
Those who offered up their soul, body and wealth for the Name became honoured, here and hereafter.
ਆਪਨੜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਿਆ; ਨਿਤ ਕੇਲ ਕਰੰਤੇ ॥੩॥
They became dear to their own God and enjoy spiritual bliss for ever. ॥3॥
ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਦੁ. ਜੋ ਪੀਵਤੇ; ਬਿਖਲੀ ਪਤਿ ਕਮਲੀ ॥
Evil counsel is a wine; those who drink it become wicked and crazed in vices.
ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣਿ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚ ਅਮਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੧੧੪॥
But, O Nanak, those steeped in the finest essence of God's Name acquire the true addiction to the eternal Name. ॥4॥12॥114॥
As the Guru urged me to make the effort, so I have made it, and I have begun the work of repeating God's Name.
ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਣਾ; ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
The Guru has fixed the mantra of the Name firmly in my heart; by repeating the Name I have found spiritual life. ॥1॥
ਪਾਇ ਪਰਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥
Let us fall at the feet of the true Guru, who has destroyed the wandering of our minds.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਣੀ; ਸਚੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through him God, in His mercy, has set us on the path of His eternal Name and made our lives beautiful. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਆਪਣੇ; ਸਚੁ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
The eternal Lord of the will, by His own command, has taken my hand and merged me in His feet.
ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਦਾਤਿ; ਸਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
The gift of the Name that God has given me is for me the highest honour. ॥2॥
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ; ਜਪਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
Now God's praises are sung in my heart for ever, and I keep repeating the Name of the Lord.
ਨੇਮੁ ਨਿਬਾਹਿਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ; ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
God has shown mercy; the Guru carries my practice of the Name through to the end. ॥3॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ; ਲਾਭੁ. ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤਾ ॥
The Name is now my wealth and I sing God's praises; this is the profit the perfect Guru has given me.
ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਅਮਿਤਾ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੧੧੫॥
O Nanak, say: God, the banker, is of boundless power, and His saints are the traders in His Name. ॥4॥13॥115॥
ਜਾ ਕਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਤੁਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਤਾ ਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗਾ ॥
O Lord, the one over whom You Yourself are Master has great good fortune;
ਓਹੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਸਦ ਸੁਖੀ; ਸਭੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
he lives at ease and always in comfort, and all his doubt and fear are gone. ॥1॥
ਹਮ ਚਾਕਰ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕੇ; ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
I am the servant of Gobind; my Master is the greatest of all,
ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ; ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
He who does all and causes all to be done in every way; He is my true Guru. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੋ; ਤਾ. ਕਾ ਭਉ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
There is no one else equal to God, whose fear one should hold.
400: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ. ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਜਗੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ॥੨॥
By the service the Guru teaches one finds a place at God's feet and crosses the world-ocean that is so hard to cross. ॥2॥
ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
O Lord, through Your gracious glance comes peace, and the treasure of the Name comes to dwell in the mind.
ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਭਏ; ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
O Lord, those on whom You are kind are the servants accepted at Your door. ॥3॥
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੋ; ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪੀਵੈ ॥
God's praise is the nectar that gives spiritual life; only a rare person drinks it.
ਵਜਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਿਲੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵੈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੧੧੬॥
O Nanak, the servant who receives the stipend of God's one Name gains spiritual life by repeating it in his heart. ॥4॥14॥116॥
ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ. ਹਉ ਚੇਰੁਲੀ; ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
The Lord whose humble maidservant I am is higher than all,
ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਕਾਂਢੀਐ; ਥੋਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਮੂਚਾ ॥੧॥
and everything I have, small or great, is called His. ॥1॥
ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮੇਰਾ ਧਨੋ; ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਮਨੀਆ ॥
My soul, my breath and my wealth I count as gifts from my Master.
ਨਾਮਿ ਜਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਊਜਲੀ; ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸੀ ਗਨੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
I count myself the maidservant of Him by whose Name I have been given honour. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਅਨੰਦ ਮੈ; ਨਾਉ ਮਾਣਕ ਹੀਰਾ ॥
You need no one and are ever bliss itself; Your Name is my pearl and my diamond.
ਰਜੀ ਧਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਰਾ ॥੨॥
O Lord, the soul-bride over whom You are king stays sated and is ever at peace. ॥2॥
ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਰੀ ਸੰਗ ਕੀ; ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਉ ॥
O friends and companions with me, I keep reminding you of this good counsel:
ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ; ਤਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
take the Guru's refuge with faith and love; since I did, I have been receiving God's treasure. ॥3॥
ਸਗਲੀ ਦਾਸੀ ਠਾਕੁਰੈ; ਸਭ ਕਹਤੀ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
Every soul-bride is the Master's maidservant, and each one says He is her own.
ਜਿਸਹਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਤਿਸੁ ਸੁਖਹਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੧੧੭॥
But O Nanak, she whose life the Master Himself adorns dwells in peace. ॥4॥15॥117॥
ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਦਾਸਰੀ; ਏਹੁ ਅਚਾਰਾ ਸਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥
O fair soul, stay a humble maidservant of the holy; learn just this way of living,
ਸਗਲ ਗੁਣਾ ਗੁਣ ਊਤਮੋ; ਭਰਤਾ. ਦੂਰਿ ਨ ਪਿਖੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥
and do not think the Husband-Lord far away, who holds all virtues and is highest in them. ॥1॥
ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਜੀਠੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥
O fair soul, dye this mind of yours in the fast madder colour of God's Name,
ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ; ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣੁ ਗੁਪਾਲਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
give up your cleverness and cunning, and know that the Sustainer of the world dwells with you. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਭਰਤਾ ਕਹੈ. ਸੁ ਮਾਨੀਐ; ਏਹੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਣਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
Accept as sweet whatever the Husband-Lord commands; make this your adornment.
ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ; ਏਹੁ ਤੰਬੋਲਾ ਖਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੨॥
Forget love for anything other than God; eat this betel leaf, O soul. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਪਕੋ; ਇਹ ਸਤ ਕੀ ਸੇਜ ਬਿਛਾਇ ਰੀ ॥
Make the Guru's word your lamp, and spread in your heart the bed of that spiritual life.
ਆਠ ਪਹਰ. ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਰਹੁ; ਤਉ ਭੇਟੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇ ਰੀ ॥੩॥
All eight watches stay at His feet with palms joined; then the sovereign Lord meets you. ॥3॥
ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਚਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਸਭੁ; ਸਾਈ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥
Hers alone is the good conduct and the accepted adornment, and she is held beautiful, who stays absorbed in the boundless Lord.
ਸਾਈ ਸੋੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਜੋ ਭਾਣੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੧੧੮॥
O Nanak, she alone is the blessed wife who pleases the Creator and stays absorbed in Him. ॥4॥16॥118॥
ਡੀਗਨ ਡੋਲਾ ਤਊ ਲਉ; ਜਉ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
Falling into vices and being caught by attachment last as long as the mind keeps running after Maya,
ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕਾਟੇ. ਗੁਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ; ਪਾਏ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥੧॥
but one whose wanderings the beloved Guru has cut away has found stillness. ॥1॥
ਓਇ ਬਿਖਾਦੀ ਦੋਖੀਆ; ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹੂਟੇ ॥
All those quarrelsome enemies, lust and the rest, have worn themselves out through the Guru's refuge.
ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਅਬ ਉਨੑਾ ਤੇ; ਓਇ ਹਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Now we are freed from them, and they have let go of us. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਮੇਰਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਾਨਤਾ; ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਬੰਧਾ ॥
Ever since a person began to tell mine from yours, he has been bound by attachment to Maya.
ਗੁਰਿ. ਕਾਟੀ ਅਗਿਆਨਤਾ; ਤਬ ਛੁਟਕੇ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੨॥
When the Guru removed ignorance, the nooses of attachment were undone. ॥2॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ. ਨ ਬੂਝਤਾ; ਤਬ ਹੀ ਲਉ ਦੁਖੀਆ ॥
As long as a person does not understand God's will, so long he stays in pain,
ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਤਬ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਆ ॥੩॥
but whoever recognises the will by meeting the Guru is at peace from that moment. ॥3॥
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੋਖੀਆ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
To him no one seems an enemy or a foe, and no one seems bad,
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕੋ; ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੈ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੧੭॥੧੧੯॥
O Nanak, who by the service the Guru teaches becomes God's servant, the Master's own slave. ॥4॥17॥119॥
ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦੁ ਘਣਾ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਉ ॥
I keep singing God's praise, and great peace and the bliss of stillness of mind abide within me.
ਗਰਹ. ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ; ਦੇ ਅਪਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੧॥
Giving me the Name He Himself repeats, the true Guru has removed, as it were, the troubles of all nine planets. ॥1॥
ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ; ਸਦ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
I am a sacrifice to my Guru, ever and ever I give myself to him,
